rationale: Damage to the policyholder's own kitchen cabinets and interior surfaces from an accidental grease fire is clearly property damage to the home's contents and structure.
claim_summary: Kitchen fire caused by grease flare-up on stovetop; policyholder extinguished it with a fire extinguisher. Charred kitchen cabinets above the stove and smoke damage to ceiling and walls. No injuries. Damage estimated in the medium range ($2k–$25k), requiring professional cleanup and cabinet restoration.

case_facts.description: grease fire from stovetop while sauteing onions; contained with fire extinguisher
case_facts.damage_type: charred kitchen cabinets above stove, smoke damage to ceiling and walls

rationale: Wind damage to roof shingles on the policyholder's own structure is clearly property damage covered by homeowners insurance.
claim_summary: Wind damage to four shingles on back porch overhang, estimated repair cost $400. No interior water damage. Policyholder's deductible is $2,500, so claim likely falls below deductible—adjuster should confirm coverage applicability.

case_facts.description: wind blew off approximately four shingles; no interior water damage
